author: worker_1
belief: Babur was the founder of the Mughal Empire, an Emperor, a poet, a diarist (author of Baburnama), a statesman, and a garden-builder. He ruled Fergana, Kabul, and the Mughal Empire in India.

author: worker_2
belief: Babur was the founder of the Mughal Empire and successfully conquered and claimed significant territories including Kabul, Delhi, and Agra. He was an emperor, not just a soldier.
